metadata.title: Is Nvidia heading for $1 trillion in annual revenue? One analyst now thinks that’s possible. - MarketWatch

content.text:
Is Nvidia heading for $1 trillion in annual revenue? One analyst now thinks that’s possible.
Nvidia’s stock is moving higher after earnings
Nvidia’s stock was pacing toward its best post-earnings performance in two years Thursday morning as investors welcomed the company’s outlook for sustainable strong growth.
The chip maker’s NVDA revenue and next-quarter forecast came in ahead of Wall Street’s expectations, but the real highlight was its early projection that revenue could jump more than 70% in the fiscal year that ends in January 2028. That preview was “potentially a needed catalyst for the stock,” TD Cowen analyst Joshua Buchalter said in a note to clients.
